name: The Black Box
summary: A metallic black box has turned up in a giant condor's stomach in the Badlands, its surface heavily pitted as if left in acid. Stamped on its underside, beneath a symbol, is a mark reading Engine #19 - Ironforge Siege Brigade.

sections.title: Pulled from a Condor
sections.body: The pitting suggests the box sat inside the condor for ages while acid ate at the metal. Turn it over and a symbol is stamped on the bottom, with Engine #19 - Ironforge Siege Brigade written below. You are to carry it to the Hall of Arms in Ironforge, to Pilot Longbeard.

faq.q: Where did the corroded black box come from?
aliases: where did the box come from
how did the box get here
faq.answer: It was in the stomach of a giant condor in the Badlands, and seems to have lain there a very long while.

faq.q: What markings are stamped on the box?
faq.answer: A symbol is stamped on the bottom, and beneath it is written Engine #19 - Ironforge Siege Brigade.

faq.q: Who is supposed to receive the box?
aliases: where does the black box go
who do i bring the box to
faq.answer: Pilot Longbeard, at the Hall of Arms in Ironforge.

angles.text: The box bears Ironforge's markings, and its trail ends in Ironforge.
